title: bug: CI's windows-latest step "Test PowerShell daemon autostart arguments" is red on PR #230 since edc3e937: daemon-autostart-argv.test.mjs's driver requires exactly one Start-Process passing --project in moe-agent.ps1, and CQ-M07s added a second (the check-dispatch launch, moe-agent.ps1:9617), so both PowerShell rows throw "found 2"
description:
Found by architect-67c762f6 while timing suites for task-5f5c8999 (2026-11-04 ~21:30 local).

Evidence:
- Real CI: PR #230 runs 41894749395 (headSha d05e6e0b) and 41895358687 (headSha e53f5a5c, the current tip of moe/work-2026-10-24). In both, every job is green except Build (windows-latest), and its only failed step is "Test PowerShell daemon autostart arguments" (`node --test scripts/tests/daemon-autostart-argv.test.mjs`, ci.yml, Windows only).
- Local repro: Windows node (node.exe from WSL) in a git-archive snapshot of edc3e937 on D:. `node.exe --test scripts/tests/daemon-autostart-argv.test.mjs` gives 13 pass, 2 fail: "PowerShell 5.1: the daemon-autostart Start-Process passes literal-name paths as whole arguments" and the same row for PowerShell 7. Both stderr lines say "expected exactly one Start-Process passing --project in moe-agent.ps1, found 2" (the driver's driver.ps1:7).

Cause:
- The DRIVER in daemon-autostart-argv.test.mjs (about :55) selects every CommandAst named Start-Process whose extent text contains '--project', then requires exactly one.
- edc3e937 (task-74fe4c99, CQ-M07s) added `$script:CheckDispatchProcess = Start-Process -FilePath $Node -ArgumentList (ConvertTo-MoeArgumentLine @($script:CheckDispatchCli, '--project', ...))` at moe-agent.ps1:9617.
- The daemon autostart call itself (moe-agent.ps1:1029, `@("$daemonScript", "start", "--project", "$projectPath")`) did not change. So the selector is too broad; nothing shows that the launcher misbehaves.

Expected fix: the driver selects the daemon-autostart Start-Process by what makes it that call (for example the `$daemonScript` / "start" arguments), not by '--project' alone, and keeps its exactly-one check. The plan decides the exact selector. The launcher is changed only if the plan shows why it must be.

Why HIGH: PR #230 merges only at all-green CI, and this is the one red step at the tip.
definitionOfDone: `node.exe --test scripts/tests/daemon-autostart-argv.test.mjs` (Windows node, run from WSL) passes at the landing commit with both the PowerShell 5.1 and the PowerShell 7 rows run, none skipped.

The driver still selects exactly one statement, the daemon autostart Start-Process (the call that runs $daemonScript with start --project), and still fails when that call is missing or duplicated. A mutant run (a copy of moe-agent.ps1 with that call removed, and one with it duplicated) shows each failing.
scripts/moe-agent.ps1 behavior is unchanged, unless the plan justifies a launcher change; the check-dispatch Start-Process at about :9617 is not touched.
The verification command finishes within 20 min on this host (GLOBAL gate-budget rail).

(2) Carried from my duplicate task-83f72d9f (archived):
- Only scripts/tests/daemon-autostart-argv.test.mjs changes; scripts/moe-agent.ps1 is untouched.
- The locator picks exactly the daemon-autostart Start-Process (e.g. by its daemon entry / `start` argument or enclosing function), unaffected by the check-dispatch call at moe-agent.ps1:9617 or any future `--project` Start-Process.
- Every assertion about that call is unchanged.
- It still fails on a mutant that breaks the autostart argument quoting.
- The gate is one run of the file through a Windows node, on PS 5.1 and 7. It must fit the 20-min rail.
